name: FormDAM
title: a local-first photo library and asset manager
summary: An open-source, local-first photo library with a SQLite catalog, RAW and HEIC, CLIP search, a non-destructive editor, offline maps and private albums.
lede: FormDAM is an open-source, local-first photo library and asset manager. Originals stay in a managed or referenced store with a SQLite catalog beside them, and you browse, search, organize, edit and export from one window.
runs_on: macOS, Windows and Linux, plus a browser build
checks: Imports from a path, a browsed folder or a drop, skipping exact duplicates by SHA-256 and bringing XMP sidecars along.
Reads HEIC/HEIF, 23 camera RAW extensions via LibRaw, video via ffmpeg, and full EXIF.
Searches every text field, dates, places and CLIP visual search such as "puppies in flowers".
Edits non-destructively and exports to JPEG, HEIC, PNG, TIFF or WebP.

facts.dd: FastAPI on SQLite, under a vanilla TypeScript window in a Tauri 2 shell
Backend on 127.0.0.1:8000, frontend dev server on 127.0.0.1:5173
Face, CLIP, Clean Up and Look Up models, about 650 MB on disk and about 1.2 GB downloaded once, sha256-pinned
Scripts, agents and MCP tools are off by default and turned on in Settings > Privacy

chapters.title: Import, browse and find anything
chapters.text: A day-grouped grid with Years, Months and All Photos views, eleven sort orders, stacks and combinable quick filters. One search covers every text field, dates and places, plus CLIP visual search and Advanced Find saved as smart albums.

chapters.title: A non-destructive editor
chapters.text: Light, colour, B&W, curves, levels, sharpen, noise and vignette adjustments, filters, crop and straighten, markup, and Clean Up that removes distractions with LaMa. RAW files add a develop section, and every edit can be reverted.

chapters.title: Private by design
chapters.text: Private albums need a passkey and vanish from every general view. Share as Encrypted Package makes a WinZip AES-256 zip, and location is stripped losslessly unless you include it. Only the app window reaches the engine by default.

features.title: Import
features.text: Paste a path, browse a folder or drop files and folders anywhere, including onto an album.
bullets: Files are copied, moved or added in place (referenced)
SHA-256 fingerprints, filed as an import batch
Exact duplicates are skipped at the door
XMP sidecars from Bridge or Lightroom bring ratings, labels, keywords and IPTC

features.title: Formats and metadata
features.text: Wide format coverage with full metadata.
bullets: HEIC/HEIF and 23 camera RAW extensions via LibRaw
Video via ffmpeg
EXIF, GPS, lens and exposure
Apple maker notes: Live Photo pairing, bursts, selfies, portraits, and QuickTime tags

features.title: Library grid
features.text: Day-grouped tiles with fast selection and infinite scroll via keyset cursors.
bullets: Years, Months and All Photos views with a zoom slider
Quick filters for media types, rating, label and keyword
Eleven sort orders and stacks
Cmd-click and Shift-click selection

features.title: Viewer
features.text: Full-size photos and range-streamed video with an info panel.
bullets: Camera data, location, keywords, people, subjects and recognised text
Ratings and labels from the keyboard
Download and delete

features.title: Organize
bullets: 0-5 stars, seven colour labels and reject
Titles, captions and alt text
A hierarchical keyword manager, smart albums, album folders and pinned views
Batch rename with tokens
Show in Finder and Edit With, with each save coming back as a revertible edit

features.title: Search
features.text: One search over every text field, dates and places, plus CLIP.
bullets: CLIP search such as "puppies in flowers"
Suggestions
Advanced Find (Cmd-F) saved as smart albums

features.title: Places
features.text: Offline geography with no map service needed.
bullets: Offline reverse geocoding and an offline map with clustered thumbnails
City and country collections and trips
Location and date editing singly or in batches

features.title: Recognition
features.text: On-device recognition of people, pets, subjects and things.
bullets: People by YuNet face detection and SFace embeddings, including in video
Pets grouped per animal and content collections such as documents, receipts and QR codes
Look Up for species (about 384,000 via BioCLIP), dog and cat breeds and about 3,700 landmarks

features.title: Edit
bullets: Light, colour, B&W, curves, levels, definition, sharpen, noise, vignette
Filters, crop and straighten, markup, lens corrections
Clean Up with LaMa, Live Photo Long Exposure, copy and paste edits, video trim
RAW develop section with Kelvin white balance and tint

features.title: Output
bullets: XMP sidecars and File Info (IPTC) with templates
Export to JPEG, HEIC, PNG, TIFF or WebP with sizing, naming and metadata options
Print and PDF contact sheets, saved workflows

features.title: Sharing and sync
features.text: Encrypted packages, optional folder sync and a LAN-only family library.
bullets: Share as Encrypted Package: WinZip AES-256 zip with a generated password or your own of at least 16 characters
Sync through a folder such as iCloud Drive, Dropbox, Syncthing or a NAS, off by default
Shared Library works only on the local network between apps with the same share key

features.title: Albums, vault and Recently Deleted
bullets: Private albums require a passkey (scrypt-hashed) and disappear from every general view
One vault passkey guards Recently Deleted
Touch ID and Keychain on macOS, Windows Hello on Windows, polkit sign-in on Linux
Items auto-purge after 30 days, configurable

features.title: Duplicates
features.text: The bundled deduplakit engine finds exact and visually identical sets across photos and videos.
bullets: Dual-gradient dHash, confidence-masked DCT pHash and a color grid
Resolving keeps the best copy and trashes the rest, reversible from Recently Deleted

features.title: Curation and libraries
bullets: Memories, generated or described, with generated music
Slideshows and compare with linked zoom
Several libraries, repair and consolidate referenced files

parity.summary: Graded at zip v1.27.5 against Apple Photos for macOS 27 and Adobe Bridge 16.0.6, with Immich v3.3.1 as the open-source comparison. Every build cell was traced in code, and the references come from Apple's and Adobe's own documentation fetched on October 10, 2026.

requirements: Python 3.10 or newer for the desktop build
Rust, installed with rustup when missing
ffmpeg on PATH for video thumbnails, video dedup and video face scanning
docs.agents: Automation access for scripts, agents and MCP tools is off by default; Settings > Privacy turns it on and shows a token.

topics.title: Quickstart
topics.text: The README lists the master launcher, install only, boot only and a banner script.

topics.title: Desktop app
topics.text: build_app options such as --no-install, --install, --open and --clean, and the Windows build_app.bat.

topics.title: Configuration
topics.text: Environment variables such as FORMDAM_LIBRARY, FORMDAM_MODELS, FORMDAM_AUTOMATION and FORMDAM_TRASH_DAYS.

topics.title: Dependency licenses
topics.text: A table of every dependency, its license and where it runs.

items: Windows pins the MIME types of .js, .mjs and .css, so the window no longer stays blank
When no ffmpeg is on PATH, the engine downloads a pinned LGPL build on first run and checks every file's SHA-256
The macOS DMG keeps tauri's Developer ID signature
Windows PyInstaller data pairs use a semicolon and PyInstaller is pinned to 6.16.0
A window smoke test runs in CI
The topbar subtitle line is reserved, so the title no longer jumps
The splash logo no longer moves when the rest of the page streams in

shots_wanted.what: A photo open in the non-destructive editor

shots_wanted.what: Private albums and the Recently Deleted vault
